methods.reordered_DP: Independent forward prefix/last-three DP from normal-equation LS costs agrees with saved backward DP optimum; all10! orders are represented because each step chooses any unused label and future row cost depends only on the ordered last3 and next row.
methods.reassigned: Independent three-capacity DP for every2100 input partitions, replacing Hungarian. Search count=C(10,4)*C(6,3)/2=2100. Capacities3/3/4 give exactly3*3+3*3+4*4=34 entries.
methods.LS: np.linalg.solve on positive-definite selected covariance; independent minimum cost=A_row C A_row^T-rhs^T C_subset^-1 rhs. Saved FP32 W/bias reproduced exactly.

reordered_masked_k4.original_labels_preserved: Original row perm[i] uses native target A[perm[i]], remains stored at weight[perm[i]] and bias[perm[i]].

reassigned_continuous334.original_labels_preserved: Hungarian output row indices are original t labels; 3/3/4 output capacities, each original output occurs exactly once. Saved W row refit independently matches its own native A row.

reassigned_fit334.original_labels_preserved: Hungarian output row indices are original t labels; 3/3/4 output capacities, each original output occurs exactly once. Saved W row refit independently matches its own native A row.

material_limits: No blocking LS/label/search/state error found for these actual10x10 inputs.

Exact refers to the finite combinatorial mask family and float64 covariance-fit objective. Reported training_membrane_MSE is computed before FP32 rounding; the tiny difference is quantified, not a full-forward FP32/AEE equivalence.
The permutation is an ordinary relabeling of a causal-k4 dependency pattern, but is not causal in original time order. Reordered production/collection is required if Y is not already resident.
Four Y means three retained past values plus one arriving input; it still needs one working U and tagged completed gates. Group assignments may emit original t labels out of order.
The current square10x10 Hungarian use has sorted complete row indices; enumerate(assignments) is valid here. The code is not a general rectangular-assignment implementation.
The all2100 claim covers3/3/4 disjoint input partitions and matched3/3/4 output capacities, not every arbitrary34-edge graph.
State counts retain the previous finish/last-use rule and omit width, real Conv production, SRAM ports, reorder traffic, backpressure and mapped timing. No new RTL or training performed.
